openings.claim: Threshold-directed adjudication changes selection from apparent slice improvement to disputed-label influence on acceptance. A local script tracks paired correctness differences and conservative total/slice bounds: prediction agreement contributes zero regardless of label; disagreement may contribute minus one, zero or plus one. Recompute after each adjudication. Advance only if every permitted completion satisfies gain at least four and no slice loss exceeding two; reject only if none satisfies the joint rule; otherwise unresolved.
openings.discriminator: Compared with fixed record-ID ordering of flagged rows, threshold-directed selection may reach a key-consistent decision using fewer adjudications, especially near the slice losing two. Annotator disagreement alone need not identify influential rows. Advantage disappears when influential uncertainty is diffuse or inaccessible.
openings.probe: Use two matched dataset copies with independently reset sixteen-row allowances. Compare threshold-directed selection against fixed record-ID ordering; break selection ties by record ID. Log each selected ID, rationale, returned label or withheld status, updated bounds, elapsed time and adjudication count. Attempt each withheld row once, log its unresolved contribution; failed access consumes no allowance. Stop by sixteen successful adjudications or seventy minutes. Freeze both reports before opening the sealed full-label key. Compare key consistency, affected slices, supported-decision frequency and adjudications used; unresolved is not success.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes nonflagged supplied labels are fixed and flagged labels alone need adjudication; supplied records permit conservative bounds without outside labels. Script preparation and analysis must fit seventy minutes, otherwise freeze unresolved. Withheld rows or remaining flagged uncertainty may defeat closure despite sixteen adjudications; the cap guarantees no informative result. Proposed probe, not observed improvement.

lineage.reason: Retains causal relation, complete rival/defeat prediction, probe, declared preserves fit and assumptions.

decision: Retain D1 as a bounded further-evaluation probe using only supplied records and labels, unchanged thresholds, at most sixteen adjudications and explicit uncertainty. No decision has been established. Any eventual advance authorizes another evaluation round, not deployment readiness.
